summary: Deforms spline surfaces by using one or more faces or profiles as surface-manipulation handles rather than directly editing CVs.

key_params.name: divs
key_params.note: Number of divisions used for deformation resolution.

key_params.name: deforminside
key_params.note: Apply deformation inside the projected region.

common_gotchas: Curveclay does not support polygonal mesh deformation; use spline surfaces/faces.
Projection controls only apply in modes with the required projection inputs connected.
Wrapped or seam-crossing surfaces may require higher `divs` or refinement and can broaden the affected region.
key_concepts: Curveclay SOP deforms spline surfaces with faces or profiles used as manipulation handles.
The number of connected inputs changes the working mode: displacement, projection, or combined face/surface deformation.
Curveclay is for spline surfaces and faces, not polygonal meshes.
`divs`, `sharp`, and `refine` trade deformation quality against cook cost and localized refinement.
